name: codex-smart-factory
target: OpenAI Codex Windows app and Codex CLI on Windows

design.essential_rules: full global AGENTS.override; no lazy dependency
design.single_windows_entrypoint: CODEX_SMART_FACTORY.cmd auto install/update + health + optional advanced subcommands
design.powershell_resolution: absolute Windows PowerShell / Sysnative / PowerShell 7 / PATH fallback
design.routing: local heuristic + live model catalog + exact codex exec leaf
design.mission_control: single integrated task DAG + per-task model routing + progress/findings + deterministic resume + quota watchdog
design.safe_stop: structured quota preflight plus task-boundary/periodic checkpointing
